<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Sakshi Jedhe | Aspiring Software Engineer</title>
<meta name="description" content="Portfolio of Sakshi Jedhe, B.Tech CSE student skilled in Java, DSA, SQL and web development.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#141519">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ===== Tokens ===== */
:root {
--bg: #17181c;
--bg-alt: #1d1e24;
--card: #22232a;
--line: #34353f;
--text: #f3f3f6;
--muted: #b4b5c0;
--violet: #8b7cff;
--blue: #4cc9ff;
--grad: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--violet), var(--blue));
--font: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
--mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;
--radius: 12px;
--header-h: 64px;
}
/* ===== Base ===== */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: calc(var(--header-h) + 8px); }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 400 1rem/1.7 var(--font); overflow-x: hidden; }
h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 .75rem; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 3.6rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
h2 { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.2rem); margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; }
p { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--muted); }
ul, ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
a { color: var(--blue); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
a:hover { color: var(--text); }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }
.wrap { width: min(1100px, 100% - 2.5rem); margin-inline: auto; }
.narrow { max-width: 760px; }
.sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }
.skip { position: absolute; left: 1rem; top: -4rem; background: var(--text); color: var(--bg); padding: .5rem 1rem; z-index: 100; border-radius: 6px; }
.skip:focus { top: 1rem; }
/* ===== Header and CSS-only mobile menu ===== */
.nav-toggle { position: fixed; top: 14px; right: 14px; width: 40px; height: 36px; opacity: 0; z-index: 60; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.site-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: rgba(23, 24, 28, .92); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: var(--header-h); gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.brand { color: var(--text); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.burger { width: 40px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; }
.burger span, .burger span::before, .burger span::after { display: block; width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; transition: transform .25s, opacity .25s; }
.burger span { position: relative; }
.burger span::before, .burger span::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; }
.burger span::before { top: -7px; }
.burger span::after { top: 7px; }
.nav-toggle:focus-visible ~ .site-header .burger { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 6px; }
.nav-toggle:checked ~ .site-header .burger span { background: transparent; }
.nav-toggle:checked ~ .site-header .burger span::before { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
.nav-toggle:checked ~ .site-header .burger span::after { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }
.site-header nav { display: none; width: 100%; padding-bottom: .75rem; }
.nav-toggle:checked ~ .site-header nav { display: block; }
.site-header nav a { display: block; padding: .75rem .25rem; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.site-header nav a:hover { color: var(--text); }
/* ===== Buttons ===== */
.actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .75rem; margin-top: 1.75rem; }
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: .6rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text); background: var(--card); font: 600 .95rem var(--font); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; }
.btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--violet); }
.btn.primary { background: var(--grad); color: #101014; border-color: transparent; }
.btn.primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(139, 124, 255, .35); color: #101014; }
/* ===== Hero ===== */
.hero { position: relative; padding: 4rem 0 5rem; overflow: hidden; }
.hero::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 520px; height: 520px; right: -160px; top: -180px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(139, 124, 255, .22), transparent 65%); pointer-events: none; }
.hero-grid { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 2.5rem; align-items: center; }
.role { color: var(--blue); font: 500 1rem var(--mono); margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.lead { max-width: 60ch; }
.photo { position: relative; margin: 0; width: min(72vw, 320px); aspect-ratio: 1; justify-self: center; padding: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--grad); box-shadow: 0 0 70px rgba(139, 124, 255, .4); animation: rise .8s ease-out both; }
.photo::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -16px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px dashed rgba(139, 124, 255, .55); animation: spin 40s linear infinite; }
.photo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 9%; right: 1%; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue); box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--blue); }
.photo img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 50%; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid var(--bg); }
.photo figcaption { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -16px; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 2; white-space: nowrap; padding: .35rem .9rem; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; font: 500 .8rem var(--mono); color: var(--text); }
.name { background: var(--grad); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }
/* ===== Sections ===== */
.section { padding: 4.5rem 0; }
.section.alt { background: var(--bg-alt); }
.grid { display: grid; gap: 1.25rem; }
.card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.5rem; }
.card p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.highlight { border-left: 3px solid var(--violet); }
.highlight + .highlight { margin-top: 1.25rem; }
/* Tags */
.tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-top: .75rem; }
.tags li { padding: .25rem .7rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; font-size: .88rem; color: var(--text); background: var(--bg); }
.tags.mono li { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: .8rem; color: var(--blue); }
/* Projects */
.project { display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: transform .25s, border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
.project:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: var(--violet); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(139, 124, 255, .15); }
.project .tags { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.link { margin-top: auto; font-weight: 600; }
/* Timeline */
.timeline { position: relative; padding-left: 1.75rem; border-left: 2px solid var(--line); }
.timeline li { position: relative; padding-bottom: 1.75rem; }
.timeline li:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
.timeline li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: calc(-1.75rem - 7px); top: .35rem; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--violet); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--bg-alt), 0 0 12px var(--violet); }
.timeline p { margin: 0; }
/* Contact */
.details li { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: .75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.details span:not(.sr) { color: var(--muted); font: 400 .85rem var(--mono); }
form .field { display: block; margin-top: 1rem; }
form .field:first-of-type { margin-top: 0; }
form label { display: block; margin: 0 0 .35rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: .92rem; }
input, textarea { display: block; width: 100%; padding: .7rem .9rem; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; }
input:focus, textarea:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); border-color: transparent; }
textarea { resize: vertical; }
form .btn { margin-top: 1.25rem; }
.note { font-size: .85rem; margin: .75rem 0 0; }
/* Footer */
.site-footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: .5rem 0; }
.site-footer p { margin: 0; font-size: .9rem; }
.social { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1.25rem; }
.social a { display: inline-block; padding: .6rem 0; font-size: .92rem; }
/* Resume */
.resume-sheet { max-width: 820px; overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35); }
.resume-sheet img { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 620px; height: auto; }
#resume .actions { margin-top: 1.25rem; }
/* ===== Animation ===== */
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
/* ===== Larger screens ===== */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
.nav-toggle, .burger { display: none; }
.site-header nav { display: block; width: auto; padding: 0; }
.site-header nav ul { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; }
.site-header nav a { padding: .5rem 0; border: 0; font-size: .92rem; }
.grid.two { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
.grid.skills { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
.hero { padding: 6rem 0 7rem; }
.hero-grid { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 4rem; }
.grid.skills { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.contact { align-items: start; gap: 3rem; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
*, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
}
</style>
</head>
